verdict.rationale: Formant is a robotics fleet-management SaaS platform, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence pack shows no MCP server. The 'Formant agent' is on-device robot software, and the Agent SDK, Cloud SDK, APIs, llms.txt and in-app AI assistant are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not an MCP endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
